# False-join rescoring results

Generated by `crates/bench/scripts/falsejoin_rescore.py publish`. Method: `README.md`. Brackets are 95% paired item-bootstrap intervals (1,000 draws, seed 20261010). C = cost_norm; FJ = fj_norm (outside mass); FJs = fjs_norm (specificity); J = C + β·FJ at β = 1. Lower is better for every score.
